heading: Empowering Zimbabwean Youth Through Integrated Technology Skills
paragraph: Geosen Press International, together with Thunderminds Association, is focused on practical technology education that connects AutoCAD design, Robotics and Coding. The programme is designed to help learners move from an idea and a technical drawing to a working intelligent machine or real-world solution.
mission: To empower Zimbabwean youth with integrated skills in AutoCAD, Robotics and Coding through practical learning, expert guidance and real-world projects.
vision: To create innovators, problem solvers and future leaders who can use technology to address local challenges and contribute to a stronger Zimbabwe.
tagline: Build Skills • Create Solutions • Shape the Future

points.point: Practical, hands-on learning using real projects
Integrated AutoCAD, Robotics and Coding skills
Project-based learning connected to Zimbabwean needs and industries
Skills that can support education, innovation, entrepreneurship and employment
A pathway from classroom learning to practical technology solutions
